name: Rummikub
description: Tile rummy for 2–4 players using 106 tiles (numbers 1–13 in four colors, two of each, plus two jokers). Players draw from the pool or meld groups and runs on the table; first to empty their rack wins. Sabra is the main version with table manipulation.

overview.description: Tile rummy for 2–4 players using 106 tiles (numbers 1–13 in four colors, two of each, plus two jokers). Players draw from the pool or meld groups and runs on the table; first to empty their rack wins. Sabra is the main version with table manipulation.

history.origins: Tile rummy games invented by Ephraim Hertzano; conceived in 1940s Romania and later developed in Israel. Introduced to Western Europe and America; Sabra became the main version; American and International versions appear in Hertzano's 1978 Official Rummikub Book.
timeline: 1940s: Conceived in Romania by Ephraim Hertzano.
Post-WWII: Hertzano emigrated to Israel; developed and hand-made first sets.
1978: Official Rummikub Book published (American, Sabra, International versions).
1980: Sabra Rummikub won Spiel des Jahres.

setup.dealing: Tiles are shuffled face down; each player takes 14 tiles onto a rack. The remaining tiles stay face down as the pool.

rules.objective: Be the first to get rid of all your tiles by melding them in valid groups and runs on the table; you may also rearrange existing table melds when adding from hand.
rules.gameplay: Each turn: either draw one tile from the pool or meld. First meld must total at least 30 from hand (groups of same number in different colors, runs of three or more consecutive same color). After that you may add tiles and manipulate table melds; at least one tile from hand must be played each turn. First to empty their rack wins.
keyRules: Groups: three or four tiles of the same number in different colors; runs: three or more consecutive numbers in the same color (1 low, no 12-13-1).
Jokers substitute for any tile; if you replace a joker with the real tile you must use the joker in a meld the same turn.
Failed manipulation within time limit: revert table, take back your tiles, draw three as penalty.

strategy.basic: Get your initial 30-point meld down early so you can manipulate the table; use jokers in runs or groups you can later reclaim with the real tile.
strategy.intermediate: Break and recombine opponents' melds when it lets you play more tiles; keep runs and groups balanced so you can add from hand without getting stuck.
strategy.advanced: Plan table rearrangements before touching tiles; use time limits to pressure opponents; when pool is low, prefer melding over drawing to reduce others' options.
tips: Place tiles from hand crosswise until your turn is complete so you can revert if you run out of time.
Joker in a group of three can be replaced by a tile of either missing color.

variations.name: Sabra Rummikub
variations.description: Default version: draw or meld each turn; initial meld 30+; table manipulation allowed; no discard pile.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Sabra is the default; engine already models this version.

variations.name: American Rummikub
variations.description: Draw one, optionally meld, then discard one; initial meld 21+; discard pile; win by melding all but one tile and discarding the last.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant differs in meld threshold and discard; overrides to be added when implementing.

variations.name: International Rummikub
variations.description: More complex scoring; can win Open, Foot, or Closed with special hand types and point values.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Complex scoring and hand types; overrides to be added when implementing.

scoring.description: Winner scores plus the sum of all losers' tile values; each loser scores minus their remaining tile total. Number tiles at face value; joker in rack counts 30 (some variants 25). Zero-sum.
scoring.winCondition: First player to play all tiles from their rack wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Tile rummy for 2–4: draw or meld groups and runs; first to empty their rack wins.
